title: No Coal
description: This mod removes all coal from Minecraft, so you can’t mine it, find it, or use it as fuel. It makes early-game survival way harder since torches and smelting become a real struggle.
body: No Coal deletes every source of coal in the game: coal ore, raw coal drops, coal in loot chests, and even villager trades. You can’t craft torches with coal, can’t smelt using it, and can’t rely on it for early fuel or XP. Players are forced to use alternatives like charcoal, lava buckets, or renewable fuels. This small change completely shifts the early-game, making caves darker, smelting slower, and progression more challenging.
